facts.fact: 医护告诉同事，Gunther 一分钟前就失去脉搏，是自己独自下到第二层、只走到一半
facts.anchor: We lost his pulse a minute ago. Looks like the poor bastard went in by himself.

facts.fact: Jade 走到尸体旁假装默哀时把手伸到尸身下，偷走 Gunther 的银表
facts.anchor: Her hand swipes low by the body, then back to her pocket.

facts.fact: Jade 因老 cultist 男人「提醒」而丢给他一枚 quarter-nox 硬币
facts.anchor: Jade drops a quarter-nox coin into the old man’s bucket.

facts.fact: Jade 从布告板撕下便条：雇主 Henry Pembroke Winchester IV 出 150 nox 请人带他去第三层取 pink glowjem
facts.anchor: Offering 150 nox. This offer is non-negotiable! -Henry Pembroke Winchester IV

facts.fact: Jade 拒接第二层 Crystal Canyon 四十 nox 的导游单，说扣税后不够本
facts.anchor: a tour of the Second’s Crystal Canyon for forty nox

facts.fact: Petra 说诊所挂靠孤儿院，是 Ms. Opal 让 Jade 在下个月满十八岁后继续住下的唯一原因
facts.anchor: let Jade continue to live there after she turns eighteen next month

facts.fact: Petra 说建诊所、办许可、买物资需要五千 nox
facts.anchor: Five thousand nox is what we need to build the clinic

facts.fact: Petra 搓热使 umula 绳散开，随后把店里其余 umula 绳全取下扔进垃圾桶
facts.anchor: I take down the rest of the umula ropes and drop them in the trash.
